caption:
Lulu's knees click every time she takes the stairs. Kneeling and squatting on site all day, it's easy to wonder if something is wearing out.

Research suggests painless knee noises are very common and usually aren't a sign of harm. What matters more is what comes with the sound. Avoiding stairs or squats because of a click can leave your legs less conditioned.

Hybi's 1-minute builder: sit-to-stands without using your hands, 10 reps × 2 sets, three times a week. Stop if pain builds or the knee swells.

Swelling after activity, locking, giving way, or clicks that started after a twist are worth an assessment. Our Sydney CBD and Chatswood physios can help. Book online via the link in bio.
